ucs.title: [LLM] APT10 / MenuPass DLL sideloading: signed host EXE pairing with trojanised sibling DLL from user-writable path (LODEINFO / ANEL / PlugX)
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical APT10 / Stone Panda / Cloudhopper sideloading combinations — legitimate signed third-party binaries (jjs.exe, K7TSecurity.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, GUP.exe, iusb3mon.exe, RtCRU64.exe, McOemSpf.exe, ushata.exe, TmDbg.exe) ship into Temp / AppData / ProgramData alongside their malicious twin DLLs (jli.dll, vssapi.dll, K7TSMain.dll, wsc.dll, libcurl.dll, RtkAudUService64.dll, RasTls.dll) to load LODEINFO, ANEL/UPPERCUT, QuasarRAT and PlugX implants. The actor signature is the pair, not either half on its own — the host EXEs are legitimately signed and the DLL names mimic real vendor
ucs.splunk:
`sysmon` EventCode=7
| rex field=Image "(?i)(?<HostBinaryLeaf>[^\\\\]+)$"
| rex field=ImageLoaded "(?i)(?<DllLeaf>[^\\\\]+)$"
| eval HostBinaryLeaf=lower(HostBinaryLeaf), DllLeaf=lower(DllLeaf)
| where HostBinaryLeaf IN ("jjs.exe","k7tsecurity.exe","k7tsmain.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","gup.exe","iusb3mon.exe","rtcru64.exe","mcoemspf.exe","ushata.exe","tmdbg.exe","vstskmgr.exe")
    AND DllLeaf IN ("jli.dll","vssapi.dll","k7tsmain.dll","wsc.dll","libcurl.dll","iusb3mon.dll","rtkaudusservice64.dll","mcoemspf.dll","rastls.dll","tmdbg.dll","tmtdi.dll")
    AND NOT match(Image, "(?i)^C:\\\\Program Files")
    AND NOT match(Image, "(?i)^C:\\\\Windows\\\\System32")
    AND NOT match(Image, "(?i)^C:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64")
| stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Image) as host_paths values(ImageLoaded) as dll_paths values(user) as users by host, HostBinaryLeaf, DllLeaf
| `security_content_ctime(first_seen)`
ucs.kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["jjs.exe","K7TSecurity.exe","K7TSMain.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","GUP.exe","iusb3mon.exe","RtCRU64.exe","McOemSpf.exe","ushata.exe","TmDbg.exe","VsTskMgr.exe"]);
let SideloadDlls = dynamic(["jli.dll","vssapi.dll","K7TSMain.dll","wsc.dll","libcurl.dll","iusb3mon.dll","RtkAudUService64.dll","McOemSpf.dll","RasTls.dll","TmDbg.dll","tmtdi.dll"]);
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SideloadHosts)
| where FileName in~ (SideloadDlls)
| where InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
     and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
     and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
     and InitiatingProcessFolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64"
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
     and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
     and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
     and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          HostBinary = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          HostBinaryPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          HostBinarySHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256,
          SideloadedDll = FileName,
          SideloadedDllPath = FolderPath,
          SideloadedDllSHA256 = SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["jjs.exe","k7tsecurity.exe","k7tsmain.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","gup.exe","iusb3mon.exe","rtcru64.exe","mcoemspf.exe","ushata.exe","tmdbg.exe","vstskmgr.exe"]);
let SideloadDlls = dynamic(["jli.dll","vssapi.dll","k7tsmain.dll","wsc.dll","libcurl.dll","iusb3mon.dll","rtkaudusservice64.dll","mcoemspf.dll","rastls.dll","tmdbg.dll","tmtdi.dll"]);
Event
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Source =~ "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 7
| extend Image = extract(@"(?is)<Data Name=""Image"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData),
         ImageLoaded = extract(@"(?is)<Data Name=""ImageLoaded"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData),
         UserField = extract(@"(?is)<Data Name=""User"">([^<]+)</Data>", 1, EventData)
| where isnotempty(Image) and isnotempty(ImageLoaded)
| extend HostLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(Image, "\\")[-1])),
         DllLeaf  = tolower(tostring(split(ImageLoaded, "\\")[-1]))
| where HostLeaf in (SideloadHosts) and DllLeaf in (SideloadDlls)
| where Image !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
     and Image !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
     and Image !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64"
| where ImageLoaded !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
     and ImageLoaded !startswith @"C:\Windows\System32"
     and ImageLoaded !startswith @"C:\Windows\SysWOW64"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, UserField,
          HostBinary = Image, SideloadedDll = ImageLoaded
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT10 / MenuPass DLL sideloading host binary executing from user-writable location
id: a3a91410-5d8f-4f01-9c2a-9c97a3d3a7a1
status: experimental
description: Detects known APT10 / Stone Panda / MenuPass DLL-sideloading host executables (jjs.exe, K7TSecurity.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, GUP.exe, iusb3mon.exe, RtCRU64.exe, McOemSpf.exe, ushata.exe) running from a non-standard user-writable directory. APT10 ships these signed third-party EXEs alongside trojanised sibling DLLs (jli.dll/vssapi.dll/K7TSMain.dll/wsc.dll/libcurl.dll/RasTls.dll) into Temp / AppData / ProgramData / Public / Downloads to load LODEINFO, ANEL/UPPERCUT and PlugX implants.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045/
    - https://www.jpcert.or.jp/english/at/2020/at200017.html
    - https://www.pwc.co.uk/issues/cyber-security-data-privacy/research/cloud-hopper.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
    - attack.defense_evasion
    - attack.t1574.002
    - attack.t1574.001
    - attack.t1036.005
    - attack.g0045
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_binary:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\jjs.exe'
            - '\K7TSecurity.exe'
            - '\K7TSMain.exe'
            - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
            - '\GUP.exe'
            - '\iusb3mon.exe'
            - '\RtCRU64.exe'
            - '\McOemSpf.exe'
            - '\ushata.exe'
            - '\TmDbg.exe'
            - '\VsTskMgr.exe'
    selection_path:
        Image|contains:
            - '\Users\Public\'
            - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
            - '\AppData\Roaming\'
            - '\ProgramData\'
            - '\Downloads\'
            - '\Windows\Temp\'
            - '\PerfLogs\'
    condition: selection_binary and selection_path
fields:
    - User
    - Image
    - CommandLine
    - ParentImage
    - ComputerName
falsepositives:
    - Vendor uninstaller / repair tooling temporarily relocating binaries
    - Forensic / IR teams running portable copies of signed vendor utilities
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\jjs.exe OR *\JJS.EXE OR *\K7TSecurity.exe OR *\K7TSECURITY.EXE OR *\k7tsecurity.exe OR *\K7TSMain.exe OR *\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\GUP.exe OR *\gup.exe OR *\iusb3mon.exe OR *\IUSB3MON.EXE OR *\RtCRU64.exe OR *\McOemSpf.exe OR *\ushata.exe OR *\TmDbg.exe OR *\VsTskMgr.exe) @Image:(*\Users\Public\* OR *\AppData\Local\Temp\* OR *\AppData\Roaming\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\Downloads\* OR *\Windows\Temp\* OR *\PerfLogs\* OR *\users\public\* OR *\appdata\local\temp\* OR *\appdata\roaming\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\downloads\*) -@Image:(*\Program Files\* OR *\Program Files (x86)\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(jjs|K7TSecurity|K7TSMain|wsc_proxy|GUP|iusb3mon|RtCRU64|McOemSpf|ushata|TmDbg|VsTskMgr)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(Users\\Public|AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|ProgramData|Downloads|Windows\\Temp|PerfLogs)\\/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function={ count(), min(_time), max(_time), values(CommandLine), values(SHA256HashData) })
ucs.rationale: Generic 'DLL sideloading' is a noisy category. This UC is APT10-specific because it pins on the exact host-binary↔malicious-DLL pairs publicly attributed to MenuPass / Stone Panda by JPCERT, PwC (Cloud Hopper), TrendMicro and Kaspersky — e.g. jjs.exe pairing with jli.dll (LODEINFO), K7TSecurity.exe with K7TSMain.dll (PlugX), wsc_proxy.exe with wsc.dll (QuasarRAT), GUP.exe with libcurl.dll (PlugX),

ucs.title: [LLM] APT10 / Cloud Hopper MSP-style RDP fan-out followed by AD reconnaissance (csvde / adfind / nltest / net group)
ucs.description: Catches the APT10 Cloudhopper / Operation Soft Cell tradecraft: a single account RDPs from one source IP into ≥4 distinct downstream hosts within a short window, then within 2 hours runs APT10's signature AD enumeration toolkit (csvde, adfind, nltest /domain_trusts, net group "Domain Admins" /domain, ldifde). This chain is the textbook MSP-pivot pattern documented across PwC Cloud Hopper, BAE Systems, and the 2018 U.S. DOJ indictment of APT10 operators.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true
    dc(Authentication.dest) as distinct_dest_hosts
    values(Authentication.dest) as dest_hosts
    min(_time) as first_logon
    max(_time) as last_logon
  from datamodel=Authentication
  where Authentication.action="success"
    AND Authentication.signature_id="4624"
    AND Authentication.authentication_method="10"
    AND NOT match(Authentication.user, "(?i)\$$")
    AND NOT match(Authentication.user, "(?i)^(system|local service|network service|anonymous logon)$")
  by Authentication.user Authentication.src
| rename Authentication.user as user Authentication.src as src
| where distinct_dest_hosts >= 4
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=true
        min(_time) as recon_time
        values(Processes.process) as recon_cmd
        values(Processes.dest) as recon_host
        values(Processes.process_name) as recon_binary
      from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
      where (Processes.process_name IN ("csvde.exe","adfind.exe","ldifde.exe")
          OR (Processes.process_name="nltest.exe" AND (Processes.process="*/domain_trusts*" OR Processes.process="*/dclist*" OR Processes.process="*/dsgetdc*"))
          OR (Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Domain Admins*" OR Processes.process="*Enterprise Admins*" OR Processes.process="*group /domain*" OR Processes.process="*user /domain*"))
          OR (Processes.process_name="dsquery.exe" AND (Processes.process="*user*" OR Processes.process="*computer*" OR Processes.process="*group*")))
      by Processes.user
    | rename Processes.user as user
  ]
| where recon_time >= first_logon AND recon_time <= (first_logon + 7200)
| table first_logon recon_time user src distinct_dest_hosts dest_hosts recon_host recon_binary recon_cmd
| sort - first_logon
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanOutThreshold = 4;       // ≥4 distinct downstream hosts in one RDP burst
let ReconWindow = 2h;          // recon expected within 2h of pivot
let RdpLogons = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | where LogonType == "RemoteInteractive"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteIP)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service","anonymous logon");
let FanOut = RdpLogons
    | summarize DistinctDestHosts = dcount(DeviceName),
                DestHosts = make_set(DeviceName, 25),
                FirstLogon = min(Timestamp),
                LastLogon  = max(Timestamp)
                by AccountName, RemoteIP
    | where DistinctDestHosts >= FanOutThreshold;
let ReconProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "csvde.exe")
         or (FileName =~ "adfind.exe")
         or (FileName =~ "ldifde.exe")
         or (FileName =~ "nltest.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/domain_trusts","/dclist","/dsgetdc"))
         or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Domain Admins","Enterprise Admins","group /domain","user /domain"))
         or (FileName =~ "dsquery.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("user","computer","group"));
FanOut
| join kind=inner (ReconProcs) on $left.AccountName == $right.AccountName
| where Timestamp between (FirstLogon .. FirstLogon + ReconWindow)
| project FirstLogon, ReconTime = Timestamp,
          AccountName, RemoteIP,
          DistinctDestHosts, DestHosts,
          ReconHost = DeviceName,
          ReconBinary = FileName,
          ReconCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| order by FirstLogon desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let FanOutThreshold = 4;
let ReconWindow = 2h;
let RdpLogons = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4624
    | where LogonType == 10           // RemoteInteractive / RDP
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | where TargetUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE","ANONYMOUS LOGON")
    | where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress != "-";
let FanOut = RdpLogons
    | summarize DistinctDestHosts = dcount(Computer),
                DestHosts = make_set(Computer, 25),
                FirstLogon = min(TimeGenerated)
                by TargetUserName, IpAddress
    | where DistinctDestHosts >= FanOutThreshold;
let ReconProcs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ProcLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where (ProcLeaf == "csvde.exe")
         or (ProcLeaf == "adfind.exe")
         or (ProcLeaf == "ldifde.exe")
         or (ProcLeaf == "nltest.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("/domain_trusts","/dclist","/dsgetdc"))
         or (ProcLeaf in ("net.exe","net1.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("Domain Admins","Enterprise Admins","group /domain","user /domain"))
         or (ProcLeaf == "dsquery.exe" and CommandLine has_any (" user"," computer"," group"));
FanOut
| join kind=inner (ReconProcs) on $left.TargetUserName == $right.SubjectUserName
| where TimeGenerated between (FirstLogon .. FirstLogon + ReconWindow)
| project FirstLogon,
          ReconTime = TimeGenerated,
          AccountName = TargetUserName,
          RemoteIP = IpAddress,
          DistinctDestHosts, DestHosts,
          ReconHost = Computer,
          ReconBinary = NewProcessName,
          ReconCmd = CommandLine
| order by FirstLogon desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT10 / Cloud Hopper post-pivot Active Directory reconnaissance commands
id: 1bcb22a0-7e3f-44e7-8cd0-7e89d1f9b2d1
status: experimental
description: Detects the canonical APT10 / MenuPass / Cloudhopper AD reconnaissance toolkit (csvde, adfind, ldifde, nltest /domain_trusts, net group "Domain Admins" /domain) executed during MSP-pivot intrusions. Best paired with an RDP fan-out signal as a correlation rule, but is high enough fidelity standalone in environments without legitimate adfind usage.
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045/
    - https://www.pwc.co.uk/issues/cyber-security-data-privacy/research/cloud-hopper.html
    - https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/two-chinese-hackers-associated-ministry-state-security-charged-global-computer-intrusion
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
    - attack.discovery
    - attack.t1087.002
    - attack.t1018
    - attack.t1482
    - attack.t1199
    - attack.g0045
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_csvde:
        Image|endswith: '\csvde.exe'
    selection_adfind:
        Image|endswith: '\adfind.exe'
    selection_ldifde:
        Image|endswith: '\ldifde.exe'
    selection_nltest:
        Image|endswith: '\nltest.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '/domain_trusts'
            - '/dclist'
            - '/dsgetdc'
    selection_net:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\net.exe'
            - '\net1.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'Domain Admins'
            - 'Enterprise Admins'
            - 'group /domain'
            - 'user /domain'
    condition: 1 of selection_*
fields:
    - User
    - Image
    - CommandLine
    - ParentImage
    - ComputerName
falsepositives:
    - Domain administrators running scheduled enumeration scripts
    - Identity / asset management tooling (Tenable AD, BloodHound on-prem, SolarWinds)
level: medium
ucs.datadog_query:
source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) @EventID:(4688 OR 1) (@Image:(*\csvde.exe OR *\CSVDE.EXE OR *\Csvde.exe OR *\adfind.exe OR *\AdFind.exe OR *\ADFIND.EXE OR *\ldifde.exe OR *\LDIFDE.EXE) OR (@Image:(*
ltest.exe OR *\NLTEST.EXE OR *\Nltest.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*"/domain_trusts"* OR *"/dclist"* OR *"/dsgetdc"*)) OR (@Image:(*
et.exe OR *\NET.EXE OR *\Net.exe OR *
et1.exe OR *\NET1.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"Domain Admins"* OR *"Enterprise Admins"* OR *"group /domain"* OR *"user /domain"*))) -@SubjectUserName:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE" OR "ANONYMOUS LOGON")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\csvde\.exe$/i
   OR ImageFileName=/\\adfind\.exe$/i
   OR ImageFileName=/\\ldifde\.exe$/i
   OR (ImageFileName=/\\nltest\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/\/(domain_trusts|dclist|dsgetdc)/i)
   OR (ImageFileName=/\\net1?\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(Domain Admins|Enterprise Admins|group \/domain|user \/domain)/i))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE|ANONYMOUS LOGON)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function={ count(), min(_time), values(CommandLine) })
| join({
    #event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=10
    | groupBy([UserName, RemoteAddressIP4], function={ dcount(aid, as=distinct_dest_hosts), values(ComputerName, as=dest_hosts) })
    | distinct_dest_hosts >= 4
